instruction.description: Fulfil the subject, purpose, style and explicitly requested flows. Do not add requirements.

anchors.0: Subject or purpose is wrong; the basic requested activity is unavailable.
anchors.1: Correct theme but the main requested flow is missing.
anchors.2: A main flow works, with a substantial requested flow missing or broken.
anchors.3: Core flows work; name the specific minor requested omission.
anchors.4: All stated requirements are delivered coherently across tested states.

spatial.description: Judge task-relevant geometry, scale, depth, occlusion, materials, lighting and key viewpoints.

anchors.0: No relevant effective 3D content or the key subject is absent.
anchors.1: Recognizable attempt with severe shape, connection or depth errors.
anchors.2: Initial view works but operation reveals major spatial or material errors.
anchors.3: Key views are coherent with local surface, lighting or material defects.
anchors.4: Shapes, spatial relations, lighting and materials consistently serve the task.

interaction.description: Judge discoverability, meaningful feedback, sequences, recovery and advertised controls.

anchors.0: Required primary operation cannot be performed.
anchors.1: Controls react superficially without the promised scene/state change.
anchors.2: Single actions work but sequences or required recovery fail.
anchors.3: Required and repeated flows work, with local discoverability or transition issues.
anchors.4: Sequences, combinations and recovery remain reliable and natural.

visual.description: Judge composition, type, color, hierarchy and a coherent expression serving this brief.

anchors.1: Severe overlap or missing hierarchy; requested style is not recognizable.
anchors.2: Readable basic style, with obvious UI/scene or layout inconsistencies.
anchors.3: Composition, typography, color and 3D form a coherent expression.
anchors.4: Purposeful details and state transitions consistently improve understanding.

stability.description: Judge resources, desktop/mobile layout and repeated operation; no uncalibrated performance thresholds.

anchors.0: Opening is followed by a blocking failure.
anchors.1: Frequent missing key resources, freezes or crashes.
anchors.2: Usable in the main view but major narrow-layout or repeat-operation problems.
anchors.3: Reliable tested flows, with local nonblocking and explained issues.
anchors.4: All standard and repeat checks are stable, readable and reliably loaded.

checks.requirement: Inspect genuine task-relevant depth and geometry across at least three distinct views where appropriate; fixed-camera designs may use read-only runtime probes.
Inspect composition, materials, light, color and legibility without preferring realism, a framework or a particular aesthetic.
Exercise the primary UI and verify meaningful scene/state feedback; do not invent extra controls.
Exercise repeat, reverse, boundary and recovery behavior appropriate to the requested and advertised flows.
Inspect 1440x900 and 390x844 layouts, lower controls, reload and console/resource diagnostics. A narrow viewport does not certify real touch hardware.
